prompt: Online shopping isn't easy any more. My parcels arrive (slowly) than before, and delivery costs (much) than it used to. I also buy (few) things online than I did. The corner shop sounds great to me.
explanation_ru: Наречие на -ly образует сравнительную степень через more (more slowly), для глагола costs используется more, а с исчисляемым существительным things — fewer.

prompt: Rajesh says this cotton cloth is the same like the blue one.
answer: Rajesh says this cotton cloth is the same as the blue one.
accepted_answers: Rajesh says this cotton cloth is the same as the blue one.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить like после the same; правильно всегда the same as.

prompt: If I add more items for free delivery, I waste more money. → The more items …
answer: The more items I add for free delivery, the more money I waste.
accepted_answers: The more items I add for free delivery, the more money I waste.
explanation_ru: Зависимость «чем больше…, тем больше…» передаётся конструкцией the + сравнительная степень в обеих частях предложения.

prompt: "Did you notice anything strange about this coffee tin, Thanasis?" "Yes, it is just (tall) the old one, but there is (little) coffee inside than before. Even worse, it costs (far / much) than it did in spring. Why do shops think we won't notice?"
explanation_ru: Равенство размеров передаётся через as tall as, с неисчисляемым coffee нужно less, а для усиления сравнения перед more ставится far.

prompt: At Luton Airport, staff weigh Brendan's small music bag, but they ignore a passenger carrying three huge shopping bags. Which sentence describes his complaint accurately?
options: My small bag isn't nearly as heavy as that passenger's bags, so why weigh mine?
My small bag is twice as heavy as that passenger's bags, so why weigh mine?
My small bag is heavier than that passenger's bags, so please weigh theirs too.
My small bag weighs the same as that passenger's bags, so both should be checked.
explanation_ru: Маленькая сумка гораздо легче трёх огромных пакетов, поэтому по смыслу подходит конструкция неравенства isn't nearly as heavy as.

prompt: "The storm is getting worse, Douglas — should we still wait for this delayed flight?" "Honestly, the coastal train runs (smoothly) in heavy rain than small planes do. The journey may take a bit (long), but it is (a lot / safe) than flying in this wind. Let's buy tickets at the station before the train leaves."
explanation_ru: Сравнение двух вариантов: наречие smoothly требует more smoothly, наречие long — формы longer, а усилитель a lot ставится перед сравнительной степенью safer.

prompt: The more neatly you pack your chargers, more quickly you will pass through airport security.
answer: The more neatly you pack your chargers, the more quickly you will pass through airport security.
accepted_answers: The more neatly you pack your chargers, the more quickly you will pass through airport security.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — опускать артикль the во второй части конструкции the…, the…; правильно the more quickly.

prompt: Akane's green suitcase looked almost ___ Mia's, so they took the wrong bags.
options: the same like
as similar with
the same as
similar from
explanation_ru: С выражением the same используется союз as, а не like; с similar нужен предлог to.

prompt: The old platform signs were less clear than the new ones. → The old platform signs weren't …
answer: The old platform signs weren't as clear as the new ones.
accepted_answers: The old platform signs weren't as clear as the new ones.
The old platform signs were not as clear as the new ones.
The old platform signs weren't so clear as the new ones.
The old platform signs were not so clear as the new ones.
explanation_ru: Значение less clear than при перефразировании через отрицание передаётся конструкцией not as/so clear as.

prompt: "Which hotel room do you want, Silvan?" "The garden room is (cool) than the balcony room. We will also sleep (well) there because no cars pass outside. Let's book the garden room."
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два номера: короткое прилагательное cool получает окончание -er (cooler), а наречие well имеет неправильную сравнительную форму better.

prompt: I looked at five small boat clubs along the coast for our teenagers. The Bay Club is one of (friendly) places we visited, and the guides explain the rules (clearly) than the staff elsewhere. Best of all, it costs (little) than the harbour club, even with life jackets included. I am ready to book our lessons.
explanation_ru: После one of нужна превосходная степень (the friendliest), наречие clearly образует сравнение через more clearly, а с глаголом costs используется less.

prompt: Marin told the visiting cyclists that the seafront stays much more busy during mild November weeks than it used to ten years ago.
answer: Marin told the visiting cyclists that the seafront stays much busier during mild November weeks than it used to ten years ago.
accepted_answers: Marin told the visiting cyclists that the seafront stays much busier during mild November weeks than it used to ten years ago.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить more перед двусложным прилагательным на -y; busy образует форму busier с заменой y на i.

prompt: Sanne's guesthouse charges the exact bicycle fee that Gijs's guesthouse charges. → Sanne's guesthouse charges the same bicycle fee …
answer: Sanne's guesthouse charges the same bicycle fee as Gijs's guesthouse.
accepted_answers: Sanne's guesthouse charges the same bicycle fee as Gijs's guesthouse.
Sanne's guesthouse charges the same bicycle fee as Gijs's guesthouse does.
Sanne's guesthouse charges the same bicycle fee as Gijs's.
explanation_ru: Для сравнения одинаковой стоимости используется конструкция the same + существительное + as.

prompt: Planning a winter beach trip requires an early start. The (late) you leave your booking, the (high) the cottage prices rise and the (few) quiet rooms remain open. Guests who wait too long do not get a sea view at a fair price. Booking in autumn is always the wisest move.
explanation_ru: Конструкция the…, the… требует сравнительной степени в каждой части: later, higher и fewer перед исчисляемым rooms.

prompt: Guess what — the council finally finished the new bike lane by the canal! I cycle to work much (fast) now, and I feel (far / calm) than when I shared the road with delivery vans. My morning trip is no longer (stressful) it used to be. You should bring your bike next weekend and try it.
explanation_ru: Короткое наречие fast даёт faster, усилитель far стоит перед сравнительной степенью calmer, а после отрицания no longer используется as stressful as.

prompt: Icy rain has made the hill roads slippery, so Gregor and Sian think the train is clearly a much safer and faster choice than driving. Which sentence expresses their view best?
options: Driving in this icy rain is nearly as safe as taking the train, though a little slower.
Taking the train isn't half as fast as driving along the coastal hill roads today.
Taking the train is by far safer than driving, even though it takes twice as long.
Taking the train is far safer than driving on icy hill roads, and it will get us there much faster too.
explanation_ru: Только последний вариант передаёт оба преимущества поезда (far safer и much faster) без грамматических ошибок вроде by far safer.

prompt: I tested four small hybrid cars at the harbour hire desk before our weekend trip. The grey hatchback had (big) boot of all four, so our sports bags fitted inside (easily) than in the other models. The back seats were not quite (wide) I had hoped, but nobody felt squashed. Surprisingly, the engine ran (quietly) than I had expected. I would definitely hire it again.
explanation_ru: Среди четырёх машин нужна превосходная степень с удвоением согласной (the biggest), наречия easily и quietly берут more, а после not quite идёт as wide as.

prompt: According to Trine's report, the new electric ferry crosses the harbour almost ___ a sailing boat.
options: as silent than
as silently as
so silently like
more silently as
explanation_ru: После глагола crosses нужно наречие silently в конструкции равенства as…as; частая ошибка — ставить than или like вместо второго as.

prompt: Whenever Oswaldo carries more bags of fresh fruit up the steep bus station ramp, he walks up the hill more slowly. → The more bags of fresh fruit …
answer: The more bags of fresh fruit Oswaldo carries up the steep bus station ramp, the more slowly he walks up the hill.
accepted_answers: The more bags of fresh fruit Oswaldo carries up the steep bus station ramp, the more slowly he walks up the hill.
The more bags of fresh fruit Oswaldo carries up the steep bus station ramp, the slower he walks up the hill.
explanation_ru: Для причинно-следственного сравнения обе части начинаются с the + сравнительная степень: The more bags…, the more slowly…

prompt: My swimming turns are much more good now than in October.
answer: My swimming turns are much better now than in October.
accepted_answers: My swimming turns are much better now than in October.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — образовывать форму more good; у прилагательного good неправильная сравнительная степень better.

prompt: "Should we practise on the outdoor court or indoors, Maite?" "The outdoor court is much (hot) today. Indoors, the ball bounces (fast), so the game is more fun. Let's book the indoor court."
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух кортов у слова hot удваивается согласная (hotter), а наречие fast образует форму faster.

prompt: Brigitte reminds new club members that the harder they grip the bow, the less accurately they hit the target.
answer: Brigitte reminds new club members that the harder they grip the bow, the less accurately they hit the target.
accepted_answers: Brigitte reminds new club members that the harder they grip the bow, the less accurately they hit the target.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: в обеих частях конструкции the…, the… правильно стоят сравнительные формы наречий the harder и the less accurately.

prompt: Seoyeon plays table tennis well, and Minjun plays equally well. → Minjun plays table tennis as …
answer: Minjun plays table tennis as well as Seoyeon.
accepted_answers: Minjun plays table tennis as well as Seoyeon.
Minjun plays table tennis as well as Seoyeon does.
Minjun plays table tennis just as well as Seoyeon.
Minjun plays table tennis just as well as Seoyeon does.
explanation_ru: Равный уровень действия передаётся конструкцией as + наречие + as (as well as).

prompt: "All six climbing walls look very tall! Which one is (easy) for a beginner?" "Start on the yellow wall over there. You can climb it (safely) than the blue wall because the steps are large."
explanation_ru: Из шести стен выбирается одна — нужна превосходная степень the easiest, а при сравнении двух стен наречие safely принимает форму more safely.

prompt: "Don't buy those front-row concert tickets, Kilian! They are twice (expensive) the balcony seats, and a wide stone pillar blocks part of the stage. Up on the balcony, you hear the music (clearly) and see the players (well) than from down here. Let's save our money."
explanation_ru: После twice используется конструкция as expensive as, а при сравнении двух мест наречия переходят в more clearly и better.

prompt: After trying all five wooden guitars in the quiet side room, Hank chose the dark maple one because it had ___ sound of the lot.
options: by far brighter
easily the brightest
the most brightest
far the brighter
explanation_ru: При выборе из пяти гитар нужна превосходная степень с усилителем easily the brightest; варианты the most brightest и by far brighter грамматически неверны.

prompt: Our Tuesday choir practice is really paying off! Since we started warming up slowly, our group sings (loudly) and (smoothly) than we did in autumn. Our teacher says this is (good) winter programme our choir has ever prepared. I can't wait for you to hear us.
explanation_ru: В сравнении с осенью наречия на -ly принимают форму more loudly и more smoothly, а конструкция с has ever prepared требует превосходной степени the best.

prompt: Troy laughed because the cheap old record sounded just as clear than the brand-new copy.
answer: Troy laughed because the cheap old record sounded just as clear as the brand-new copy.
accepted_answers: Troy laughed because the cheap old record sounded just as clear as the brand-new copy.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить than в парной конструкции as…as; правильно just as clear as.

prompt: Because the print shop delivered far less song sheets than we ordered, we kindly ask visitors to share copies with the people sitting beside them.
answer: Because the print shop delivered far fewer song sheets than we ordered, we kindly ask visitors to share copies with the people sitting beside them.
accepted_answers: Because the print shop delivered far fewer song sheets than we ordered, we kindly ask visitors to share copies with the people sitting beside them.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — употреблять less с исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе; перед song sheets нужно fewer.

prompt: No other theatre in town has noisier wooden floorboards during quiet scenes than the old opera house in Buxton. → The old opera house in Buxton has …
answer: The old opera house in Buxton has the noisiest wooden floorboards during quiet scenes in town.
accepted_answers: The old opera house in Buxton has the noisiest wooden floorboards during quiet scenes in town.
The old opera house in Buxton has the noisiest wooden floorboards in town during quiet scenes.
The old opera house in Buxton has the noisiest wooden floorboards during quiet scenes of any theatre in town.
explanation_ru: Фраза No other… has noisier… than… заменяется превосходной степенью the noisiest… in town.

prompt: Faye thinks the magic show is funnier than the musical, and the tickets cost half as much. Which sentence fits her opinion?
options: The musical is funnier and cheaper than the magic show.
The magic show is funnier and much cheaper than the musical.
The magic show costs twice as much as the musical.
Both shows have the same ticket price, so either one is fine.
explanation_ru: Если билеты стоят в два раза меньше (half as much), значит, кукольный спектакль смешнее и намного дешевле мюзикла.

prompt: Our new studio microphones have changed the way we record cartoons. Actors finish each episode (quickly) than they did last winter, and they do not need (many) extra takes as before. Even on busy days, the voices sound (clean) than on our old equipment. Buying those microphones saved us hours every month.
explanation_ru: Наречие quickly образует сравнение через more quickly, с отрицанием и исчисляемым takes нужна пара as many…as, а после глагола sound — прилагательное cleaner.

prompt: When young actors speak faster on stage, their quiet jokes sound less funny. → The faster young actors …
answer: The faster young actors speak on stage, the less funny their quiet jokes sound.
accepted_answers: The faster young actors speak on stage, the less funny their quiet jokes sound.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «чем…, тем…» обе части открываются артиклем the со сравнительной степенью: The faster…, the less funny…
